replies.body: This problem is caused by the map devs being stupid enough not to create a void world then thier map, but what they did was just chunk out a huge selection of a world with MC edit. A way to fix this would be to copy the map with world edit(and only the playable part of the map) and then creating a new world with "Clean world generator" plugin that is a add on to some plugin where you can generate worlds within servers (i forgot it) and paste the map to the new void world

replies.author: Ogrey
replies.body:
The "stupid map devs" didn't create this map, and some players are stupid enough to insult others without getting their facts right.

Some void worlds that players use do STILL generate mainland/flatland chunks, as there is no definite world generator that generates void entirely. What seems to be a void world is just a flatland/mainland world replaced with a lot of air. That's it. Chunks would still generate mainlands/flatlands depending on which way they feel like loading.
There are some exceptions that DO generate air chunks, but as far as I'm concerned there is NO full void world.

Oh, and thanks for your quite detailed explaination on how to fix a map that doesn't have enough void. I so didn't know about it :)
